column1: # The reviewed fixed oniomarchy admission set (plan 083): every package its
# repository publishes, by exact name, with its role. Nothing outside this
# table is ever a candidate, even when a newer signed database lists it; a
# change needs review here and in VAPT_ONIOMARCHY_ADMITTED.
#   candidate       may serve the named inventory item (its exact name or the
#                   aliases.tsv row) as the last tier; "-" serves no item, so
#                   the row selects or installs nothing by itself
#   dependency      only as a selected package's exact declared dependency;
#                   never a root target ("-" or its dependencies.tsv name)
#   infrastructure  oniomarchy-keyring: only the source approval path
